capabilities.description: Ingests and holds the uploaded contract (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) as the immutable source of record: contract clauses (8.2, 8.7, 11.1, 14.3, 4.2) and BOQ line items (P1-P5, E1-E5) with quantities and rates, each traceable to its source document.

Builds progress claims from BOQ line items by measured quantity, computes each Interim Payment Certificate, applies 5% retention per Clause 14.3 (50% released at Taking-Over, 50% at end of Defects Notification Period), tracks 10% performance security per Clause 4.2, and routes claims through approva

Tracks days elapsed against the 730-day Time for Completion under Clause 8.2 and computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10%, per Clause 8.7; flags when the cap is approached.

Captures Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) records — inspection lots, hold points, test results, sign-offs — linked to BOQ items such as E1–E5 earthworks, with evidence retained for payment-release gating.
A single register of all project documents — contract, BOQ, drawings, ITPs, claims, correspondence, certificates — with versioning, status, and search, each entry citing its source.
Reviews submitted claims against the contract and BOQ source of record, handles disagreements on measured quantities or clause interpretation, and records determinations with an evidence trail.
